technical_and_design_decisions: Target modern Spring Cloud Stream and Spring Cloud Data Flow architecture patterns using Spring Boot and Java 17+.
Utilize Spring Shell infrastructure to implement standalone mockable testing contexts for CLI commands.
Implement Composed Job definition persistence using standard Spring Data Repositories (RDBMS / Key-Value) with abstraction for future storage backends.
Use Spring Expression Language (SpEL) engine integrated into Spring Integration headers / message enrichment mechanisms for dynamic expression bindings in Spring Cloud Stream.
Migrate legacy Spring XD modules (JDBC and Kafka) into standalone Spring Cloud Stream applications conforming to modern auto-configuration and Spring Cloud Stream Binder APIs.
assumptions: A single experienced Java / Spring Framework software engineer will perform all implementation, refactoring, and testing activities.
Existing codebase infrastructure and CI pipelines for Spring Cloud Stream and Data Flow repositories are available and accessible.
Hadoop ecosystem client libraries are compatible with Java 17 runtime dependencies.
One workday is defined as 8 productive engineering hours.

activities.activity_description: Develop and register standard HDFS sink starter module for streaming data ingestion into Hadoop HDFS, including HDFS writer configuration, rollover policies, and integration tests.
Implement Hadoop file system interaction commands (ls, cat, mkdir, rm) into the Spring Cloud Data Flow CLI shell.

activities.activity_name: Composed Job Repository Exploration and Implementation (U3)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement persistence abstractions and repository implementations to read, write, and query composed job definitions.
Develop orchestration logic and runtime engine to parse, schedule, execute, and monitor complex composed batch job graphs and workflows.
Create an isolated test harness for shell commands to enable fast, unit-level validation of CLI components without launching end-to-end stream clusters.

activities.activity_name: Dynamic Expression Binding in Spring Cloud Stream (U6)
activities.activity_description: Implement expression-based message property binding mechanics (SpEL) for microservice modules in Spring Cloud Stream.

activities.activity_name: Migrate JDBC Sink Module from Spring XD (U7)
activities.activity_description: Refactor legacy Spring XD JDBC sink into a dedicated Spring Cloud Stream JDBC sink application with modern auto-configurations and test suites.

activities.activity_name: Migrate Kafka Source Module from Spring XD (U8)
activities.activity_description: Migrate legacy Spring XD Kafka source component to Spring Cloud Stream source repository leveraging standard Kafka binders.
Perform overall integration testing across registry, shell commands, and orchestration pipeline, and update user/developer documentation.
